text_block_list.text:
One evening during summer training camp,
as I was walking along the beach—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
—I see. So you lost today's mock race too,
Rice-chan...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right...
The other girl was really, really fast...

Haru Urara and Rice Shower were chatting
as they gazed out at the sea.
It sounded like they were talking about the mock race from earlier.

As the main highlight of the camp,
the students held a 2,500m
side-by-side training run.

Unfortunately, Haru Urara suffered a crushing defeat.
I had anticipated this distance would be too long for her.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: “Still, wasn't Rice-chan better at longer distances?”

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Yeah, Rice thought so too. That's why... it makes me sad..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice used to think that maybe, just maybe,
Rice had some good qualities too...
But now, it feels like they're all gone...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice really was
a useless child after all...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, why?
Why are you being so helpless?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-But, well...
because I lost...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If you lose, do you suddenly go 'flash'
and turn into someone who can't do anything at all?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Even though Rice-chan is still
just the same Rice-chan as always?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Or is the Rice-chan talking right now
the Rice-chan who got flashed!?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um...?
I-It's not really like that, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then you can still do everything!
You're still the same Rice-chan who can run her heart out!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...!
Is that... really true...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Losing just once won't change anything!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "I've lost a whole bunch of times, but I'm still Haru Urara, right?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah...
Just stay the same, ever-smiling Urara-chan...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Right? See, I haven't changed at all!
So you're still the same Rice-chan too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
If Rice-chan being Rice-chan means
Rice-chan's Rice-cha... Huh? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, Rice-chan, you'll definitely win next time, so don't worry!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Thank you.
Somehow, I feel like everything will be all right now...
"...It's bad to eavesdrop any further. Just as I thought that and turned on my heel—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Urara-chan is amazing, isn't she?
No matter how many times she loses, she keeps looking forward...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
How can you keep going...
and giving it your all for so long?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm...?

It was a question I'd been wondering about myself.
Why does she keep running, no matter how many times she loses?
What if—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text: "It's fine. As long as you run with a smile on your face, Urara-chan, that's all that matters to us..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
It just gives me so much encouragement.
That alone makes me happy.
"—If she truly only wants to run happily and have fun, and that's genuinely all there is to it..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That's obvious, of course!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Because—I want to win!
If I don't run, I can't win, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
You know, I want everyone
to see me win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Everyone...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Well, you see, everyone in the shopping district, my friends... and Trainer too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I lose,
everyone cheers for me with big smiles!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, I think everyone will be
eeeven happier if I win!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to win!
No, I AM gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“I see...
Fufu... That's so like Urara-chan.”

"...That's right.
Haru Urara hasn't given up on winning.
Then there is only one thing left for me to do!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Rice-chan went home too, so... all right!
For some reason, I really feel like running now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should squeeze in
just a teeny bit of extra training?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Trainer!
Just in the nick of time!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking I'd love to go for a run!
What kind of training should we do?
choice_data_list: Beach dashes until the sun goes down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Tire pulling~!?
*gulp*...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Got it, I'll do it!
It really feels like proper training, after all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Lookin' forward to it~!

And so, Haru Urara was able to
build a little bit of muscle.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Until sundown...!?
Does that mean, does that mean...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Just like the manga Nei-chan was reading!
Yeah, I wanna do it, I wanna do it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Time to race the sun!

And so, Haru Urara learned how to push herself
until she was completely worn out.
